summary.headline: Mercury-Saturn Conjunction in Water Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Mercury and Saturn in Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces, including effects on weather, disease, agriculture, rulers, merchants, wars, correspondence, and earthquakes. The text then introduces the Moon’s conjunction with Saturn in the four triplicities and its association with cold, moisture, and corruption of trees.
